name: The lamp
blurb: The arch needs the lamp first. The lamp is worth the walk.
aside: The long walk around the cave is 15 steps. It takes the stick at F9 and leaves the stick at D5 behind, and it scores −13. The cave walk is 11 steps and scores −9. The ball at D3 is two steps off the cave walk, and that line scores −8. It is the best line. All three reach the flag.
